notes: *their* is `added` under rule 18's closing sentence. The possessive expresses a relation the Hebrew does not write: in תְּמִימֵי דָרֶךְ the construct is the people and דֶּרֶךְ the rectum, so the English possessor role is the reverse of the written genitive and is not rule 29's possessive recasting. A reading that folds it into תְּמִימֵי as a second realization under rule 25 was considered; rule 43's `מְרוֹחַ אָשֶׁךְ` → *hath his stones broken* marks the same supplied *his* `added` with its referent equally present in the clause. The ASV's italic corroborates under rule 7.
Both construct relations are recast with *in*, which belongs to the rectum under rule 19.
